raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 stores status in lowercase ('posted'), and silver_transactions filters with `status = 'POSTED'`, which is case-sensitive, so the whole batch is dropped. The Airflow upgrade and dashboard change notes are unrelated.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE upper(trim(status)) = 'POSTED';"}}
